description: Template compliance contracts for Phase 5 Implementation Planning documents
match_note: required_sections uses 'startswith' matching — check if output section heading starts with the pattern

module-plan.description: Dependency matrix, module details, circular dependency resolution, layered strategy, system coverage
module-plan.notes: v1.4.0: '## System Coverage' section BẮT BUỘC — liệt kê tất cả systems (covered + orphan + thin_client) từ $SYSTEM_COVERAGE_MAP (wf-plan-modules Phase 1.7/7a.11).

dependency-graph.description: Mermaid dependency graph giữa các modules — visualize layers và critical path
dependency-graph.notes: Template lưu ở doc-framework/_meta/ vì là cross-phase asset. File output nằm trong phase5-implementation/.

orphan-placeholder.description: Placeholder _NO-FEATURES.md cho orphan systems — ngăn silent skip trong Phase 5 planning
orphan-placeholder.notes: Conditional: chỉ tạo khi coverage_strategy='placeholders' AND len(orphan_systems) > 0. Template là inline trong SKILL.md (không có template file riêng). v1.4.0.

sprint-plan.description: Sprint planning doc — scope, features, estimation, DoD. Bao gồm cả security/remediation sprints.
sprint-plan.notes: Tất cả sprint files (kể cả security/remediation plan) PHẢI nằm trong sprints/ — KHÔNG tạo ở root level phase5-implementation/.

P5-00-implementation-roadmap.description: Implementation roadmap — thứ tự triển khai, sprint planning, progress tracking

feature-impl.description: Feature implementation plan — technical approach + task breakdown
feature-impl.notes: Phần A = Implementation Plan (A1-A10), Phần B = Task Breakdown (B1-B8)

stakeholder-review.description: Stakeholder review — plan cross-review, consistency, gap analysis

parallel-safe-groups.description: Phân nhóm tasks có thể chạy song song an toàn
